routes.when: an old record says login_required or unavailable for a public docs page (login/error segment inside the path, or a password-input demo)
routes.action: Those were false positives of pre-2026-10-28 gate rules; recapture the URL directly instead of asking the user to log in. See references/validation.md.

routes.when: single video share link (v.douyin.com or /video/ID) and the user wants the file
routes.action: Anonymous playback works: run capture URL --download --profile <connected context_id> once. A dismissible login dialog over a rendered video element is not a login gate (also bilibili/tiktok/youtube); do not run headless-login or ask the user to log in. Output raw/media/video-*.mp4 is muxed (audio+video).

routes.when: status contains only a short link
routes.action: Open the DOM-discovered article or short link in the same browser; match the target status ID; do not archive the link shell as full article.
Use this plugin's browser search URL and open signed note links; this error does not prove logout.
Open the redirect and confirm mp.weixin.qq.com #js_content before counting a source as read.
Inspect doctor extension disabled/connected state; do not switch to a non-browser scraper and call it browser capture.

routes.when: the page lands on chrome-error:// or about:blank after navigation
routes.action: The site is unreachable from this network, not a login or URL-format problem. Capture already retries https/http and www variants; if it still fails, use another public entry for the same content or set HTTPS_PROXY. Do not ask the user to log in.

routes.when: a silent Bing search returns zero candidates or lands back on the home page
routes.action: Image/voice search buttons are excluded from form submission; batch second pass retries the search in the visible browser, which returns results.

routes.when: a long documentation page keeps reporting scroll_budget although its text no longer changes
routes.action: Capture jumps to the page end after two unchanged snapshots; ordinary pages settle after two quiet rounds (searches, comments and lists after three).
